subject: Request: Azure private plan licensing exceptions + bridge call
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@contoso.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>; ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@contoso.com
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Private Plan — licensing & invoice path questions

Camila / Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement reviewed the private plan paperwork you shared and we have two gating items before we can sign the private plan enrollment:

1) License footprint: Contoso needs explicit language that licenses are counted per-deployment region and that we will not be charged for inactive reserved nodes during a planned maintenance window. Suggested wording attached as redlines (see SOW_Contoso_Redlines.pdf).

2) Invoice & billing path: our vendor team requires invoices to come from the ISV entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.) rather than a marketplace aggregator. Azure Marketplace private plan setups sometimes route billing through Microsoft — can you confirm how Redwood will present invoices?

We also request a short technical/contract bridge call with your licensing lead and an Azure Marketplace PM to confirm the path and the SLA credit language. Are you available this week?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Sourcing Manager
Contoso Cloud Procurement

Attachments: SOW_Contoso_Redlines.pdf (PDF, 234 KB)
From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@contoso.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan — licensing & invoice path questions

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear summary and the redlines. Quick answers up front:
- License footprint: we can update the private plan terms to explicitly define regional count semantics. We typically count "active reserved capacity" by the customer's pinned capacity group; we'll propose exact language for your legal team to review.
- Invoice path: for private plan customers we support two invoice flows: (1) Redwood-issued invoices (preferred) via our ISV billing account, or (2) Microsoft-billed (MSP) invoices when a customer requires marketplace invoicing. We can commit to Redwood-issued invoices for Contoso.

I'll schedule a 30-min bridge call with Ben (sales ops/licensing) and Markus from Legal to walk through the redlines and the invoice path. Laura, looping you in because this is a slightly atypical SLA credit ask (procurement wants an explicit credit carve-out for scheduled maintenance).

Proposed times: Wed 5/21 10:00 or Thu 5/22 15:00 PT. Which works for you?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@contoso.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan — licensing & invoice path questions

Sarah / Camila —

Thanks — we can do Wed 5/21 10:00 PT. I'll bring the standard private plan invoice template and a sample invoice flow diagram so Contoso's vendor team can validate the Redwood-issued invoice. Markus, appreciate you joining for the legal redline review.

Ben
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Azure_PrivatePlan_Terms_v3.docx (Draft terms, please review)
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@contoso.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Azure Private Plan — licensing & invoice path questions

Hi all —

Thanks for the call this morning. Notes and suggested dispositions below: 

1) License footprint language — accepted with small tweak. Proposed clause: "Licenses shall be counted per 'Pinned Capacity Group' per region. Reductions to pinned capacity become effective at the next billing cycle; scheduled maintenance windows (<=48 hours) will not be considered reductions for billing purposes provided Customer has notified Redwood at least 72 hours in advance."

2) Scheduled maintenance credit — procurement asked for automatic credit if availability drops below the SLA during scheduled maintenance. Our policy: scheduled maintenance is excluded from SLA calculations, but we can offer a one-time goodwill credit (up to 5% of monthly committed fees) for a specific maintenance event by exception. Laura — can you authorize a case-by-case exception for Contoso (they are strategic)?

3) Invoice flow — Ben confirmed Redwood-issued invoices are supported. We will include an invoice addendum to the private plan enrollment that indicates Redwood Inference, Inc. as the billing party and provides tax ID. 

I've attached a tracked version of our private plan terms with Contoso redlines incorporated (see Azure_PrivatePlan_Terms_v3.docx). Please review and send final internal approval.

-Markus
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Azure_PrivatePlan_Terms_v3.docx (tracked changes)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 14:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan — licensing & invoice path questions

Markus / team —

Contoso is important; I'm comfortable approving a one-time scheduled-maintenance goodwill credit up to 5% of the monthly committed fees for a verified maintenance incident. That should be documented as an exception in the addendum and explicitly timeboxed to the first 12 months of the private plan term. Please ensure the addendum includes:

- Eligibility criteria for the goodwill credit (post-mortem, tracking ID)
- One-time use per 12-month period
- Requirement that Contoso provide notification and evidence within 10 business days

Markus — after you incorporate, loop in Finance for the charge code; Ben, please confirm this does not materially impact the deal economics.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@contoso.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>; ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@contoso.com; amktsales@microsoft.com
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Private Plan — licensing & invoice path questions

Camila / Ben / Markus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the call. Contoso accepts the proposed license wording and the one-time maintenance goodwill credit as documented. We agree to the 12-month timebox. Please share the finalized addendum and the Redwood-issued invoice template so our vendor team can confirm tax and remittance details.

Next steps:
- Redwood to upload final addendum to the shared contract link (https://share.redwood.com/Contracts/RDW-4839/)
- Redwood to send sample invoice and upcoming invoice cadence by EOD Tue 5/27

Appreciate the help — Sarah
Sr. Sourcing Manager
Contoso Cloud Procurement
